verdict.rationale: Airweave's docs mention built-in entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling) used during agentic search, but there is no evidence of any mechanism for ml-engineers to define custom entity types, edge types, or ontology to fit a domain schema — connectors and collections are the customization surface, not memory schema. missing for 10: any docs/API for defining custom entity/edge types, schema or ontology configuration.
